title: The child's center, with and without retained feedback
description: Matched measured close-ups: the original separated tracks and an X-like junction at the residual-qualified memory candidate.
alt_text: Matched scans of the child's center. With no retained feedback, two dark contraction tracks turn away from each other; near 0.645% retained feedback, the translated close-up shows an X-like junction at the displayed resolution. Both panels share their physical spans and grayscale; the image does not certify an exact crossing.

data_source.transformation: Byte-identical audited full and mobile figures; identical physical spans, grayscale and nearest-cell rendering.

uncertainty: Finite-horizon fixed-start measurements; period labels are recurrence candidates, not verified primitive orbits.
